concepts.label: Product Architecture
concepts.description: Deliverable software components, runtimes, SDKs, agent wedges, and client-facing interfaces in the Leio platform.

concepts.label: Model & Formal Kernel
concepts.description: Category-theoretic reasoning kernel, axiom enforcement operators, probability calibration, and routing mechanisms.

concepts.label: Pricing & Commercial Economics
concepts.description: Commercial licensing, token metering tiers, input-only billing rates, and enterprise deployment options.

concepts.label: Supported Domain Ontologies
concepts.description: Formal ontology standards supported natively by Leio for physical supply chain, healthcare, e-commerce, and SRE.

concepts.label: System 1 Decision Engine
concepts.description: High-throughput decision engine that evaluates text against formal DAGs in a single forward pass without autoregressive token generation.

concepts.label: WebAssembly In-Browser Runtime
concepts.description: 189 KB standalone WASM binary compiled from Rust (olaya-wasm), executing client-side decisions in < 1 microsecond in browser memory.

concepts.label: Python Open-Weights SDK
concepts.description: Official Python SDK (pip install olaya) with PyTorch, ModernBERT, ONNX runtime, and hard-negative mining trainers.

concepts.label: Node.js MCP Server
concepts.description: Zero-install Node.js Model Context Protocol daemon (npx olaya) exposing decision tools to Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Windsurf.

concepts.label: Python MCP Server
concepts.description: Zero-install Python Model Context Protocol server (uvx olaya) providing stdio and SSE transports for AI agent integration.

concepts.label: Vercel Serverless Edge API
concepts.description: Globally distributed hosted serverless endpoint (POST /api/systemone and /api/mcp) with sub-15ms edge latency and Jev compatibility.

concepts.label: Autonomous Conveyor Sorter Agent
concepts.description: Industrial warehouse agent listening to 200kHz barcode sensor streams and firing PLC diverter chute signals using ontology down-sets.

concepts.label: Dual-View Decision Workbench
concepts.description: Interactive web workbench combining raw text input, real-time probability distributions, ancestor lineage paths, and axiom proofs.

concepts.label: IDF-Weighted Subgraph Router
concepts.description: Two-stage router with smoothed inverse document frequency to extract relevant subgraphs from massive 100k+ concept ontologies.

concepts.label: Formal Ontology Grounding
concepts.description: Deterministic projection of unstructured observation text into structured classes within a formalized Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG).

concepts.label: Subsumption Monotonicity Guarantee
concepts.description: Mathematical guarantee enforcing P(child) <= P(parent) everywhere in the ontology DAG, preventing logical hierarchy violations.

concepts.label: Disjointness Axiom Kernel
concepts.description: Category-theoretic exclusion kernel enforcing A ⊓ B = ⊥, zeroing contradictory or mutually exclusive branches in decision space.

concepts.label: Axiom Projection Operator
concepts.description: Post-softmax projection operator that mathematically proves and enforces monotonicity and disjointness across all candidate concepts.

concepts.label: Cardinality-Aware Softmax Calibration
concepts.description: Softmax scaling where temperature T scales with candidate set cardinality to prevent probability overconfidence in dense sublattices.

concepts.label: Normalized Entropy Confidence Metric
concepts.description: Calibrated decision confidence metric defined as 1 - H / ln(N), quantifying distributional peakness relative to maximum entropy.

concepts.label: Top-k Subgraph Local Extraction
concepts.description: Dynamic reduction of 100,000+ concept ontologies to a compact active sublattice (k=12) with full ancestral closure.

concepts.label: Zero-Hallucination Formal Guarantee
concepts.description: Mathematical impossibility of hallucination: outputs are bounded strictly to verified nodes in the formal ontology lattice.

concepts.label: Input-Only Token Metering
concepts.description: Pricing mechanism metering only input observation tokens at zsh.042 per 1M tokens, exactly matching Jev while outputs are free.

concepts.label: 100% Free Output Decisions
concepts.description: Guaranteed zero cost for all generated decision tokens, CURIEs, confidence values, probabilities, and JSON structured answers.

concepts.label: Developer Free Tier
concepts.description: No-cost tier providing 100,000 monthly API calls and unlimited local WebAssembly and Python SDK executions without credit card.

concepts.label: Pay-As-You-Go Scale Tier
concepts.description: Self-serve commercial tier billed at zsh.042 / 1M input tokens with automated monthly invoicing and volume tiered discounts.

concepts.label: Dedicated Enterprise VPC Tier
concepts.description: Air-gapped on-premise deployment with custom ontology ingestion, 99.999% SLA, dedicated throughput, and private model fine-tuning.

concepts.label: Jev-Compatible Billing Protocol
concepts.description: API usage response headers and metering telemetry that adhere strictly to TypeSafe AI Jev billing specifications.

concepts.label: GS1 Web Vocabulary Standard
concepts.description: Global standard ontology for trade items, retail barcodes (GTIN), food safety cold chains, and hazardous materials.

concepts.label: Human Disease Ontology (DOID)
concepts.description: Comprehensive biomedical disease taxonomy with 730+ oncology, pathology, and clinical infection classes and ICD crosswalks.

concepts.label: Schema.org Web Entity Standard
concepts.description: Universal web schema for products, organizations, reviews, actions, events, and search engine structured data.

concepts.label: Operational Incident Taxonomy
concepts.description: Taxonomy for Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), database outages, authentication breaches, and critical server alerts.

concepts.label: Basic Formal Ontology (BFO ISO/IEC 21838-2)
concepts.description: Top-level foundational ontology establishing category-theoretic separation between continuants, occurrents, and qualities.
